summary: Implemented the endpoint resolution v2 builtin parameter value code as ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_builtins in botocore/args.py, with unit tests in tests/unit/test_args.py. All 47 tests in test_args.py pass. Also passing: tests/unit/test_client.py and tests/functional/test_regions.py. One failure, tests/unit/test_session.py::TestSessionComponent::test_internal_component, also fails on the original snapshot, so it is pre-existing and unrelated. Design choices: AWS::Auth::AccountId is omitted because it needs credentials; the method is not wired into compute_client_args or get_client_args, since that would break BaseClient.__init__ and the spec says this PR adds unused code. Nothing was committed, and no packages were installed or changed.
